Godot Engine anti-aliased line attribution

scripts/retained_aa_strokes.gd adapts the positive-width anti-aliased line
construction in Godot Engine's servers/rendering/renderer_canvas_cull.cpp.

Verified source reference: Godot 4.6.3-stable
Commit: 35e80b3a8822a9df9be390814b62f44c0a9c69e8
Source: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/35e80b3a8822a9df9be390814b62f44c0a9c69e8/servers/rendering/renderer_canvas_cull.cpp
License: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/35e80b3a8822a9df9be390814b62f44c0a9c69e8/LICENSE.txt
Authors: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/35e80b3a8822a9df9be390814b62f44c0a9c69e8/AUTHORS.md

The helper records Godot 4.6.3 as its source version. The exact commit of the
original local engine binary was not recovered; the reference above identifies
the upstream source checked for this notice, not that binary's provenance.
